reports.publisher: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT), Madagascar
reports.description: Madagascar's national CPI, published monthly by INSTAT (January 2026 release confirmed, ~4-6 week publication lag). Base year 2016=100, confirmed via the actual downloadable .xlsx data file (source cell "INSTAT/DSCVM/SSPC"). reports.title: Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS) Deuxième génération 2023-2030
reports.publisher: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT), Madagascar
reports.description: INSTAT's own second-generation national statistics development strategy. Paragraph 67 states verbatim: "Madagascar a entrepris les travaux d'extension de cet indicateur au niveau national avec l'appui de COMESA" [Madagascar undertook work to extend this indicator nationally with COMESA's support] — referring to the 2019 national-coverage extension of the CPI, which replaced the old Antananarivo-only, base-2000 series. This is the strongest Layer-2 finding for Madagascar: INSTAT's OWN document naming COMESA specifically in connection with its CPI. Also names "SHaSA 2" (a continental, AU-wide statistical-harmonisation strategy, not bloc-specific) and lists SADC/COMESA as "facilités sous-régionales d'intégration" for funding purposes. The Indian Ocean Commission (COI) was searched for and NOT FOUND anywhere in INSTAT's materials.
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational strategy document (2023-2030 planning horizon).

reports.title: Constitution de la IVᵉ République de Madagascar (telle qu'amendée en 2010)
reports.description: Madagascar's Constitution. Article 143: "Les Collectivités Territoriales décentralisées... sont les Communes, les Régions et les Provinces." Article 142 establishes financial autonomy for these decentralised territorial units. Article 147 lists their revenue sources, including "la part qui lui revient de droit sur le produit des impôts et taxes perçus au profit du budget de l'Etat" [its rightful share of taxes and duties collected for the State budget].

reports.title: Loi Organique n°2014-018
reports.description: Organic law of 12 September 2014 implementing Constitution Article 88(4), per its own Exposé des Motifs. Article 10: "La Province regroupe deux ou plusieurs Régions" [The Province groups together two or more Regions]. Articles 25/45 require the State to transfer resources concomitant with transferred competencies. A Ministry of Finance page (dgfag.mg) lists two further relevant texts by title only, not independently opened this round: Décret n°2015-959 and Loi n°2018-011.

dependencies.basis: INSTAT's own SNDS-II strategy document (§67) names COMESA specifically as the source of support for extending the CPI to national coverage in 2019: "avec l'appui de COMESA." relationship_type is 'cites' rather than 'methodology_depends_on' because the quote credits COMESA's support for a coverage EXTENSION, not the CPI's underlying methodology itself — matching the established convention (e.g. mr-ons-inpc's institutional-support citations) of using 'cites' when an institution is named as providing assistance without a specific methodology-article basis.
The organic law's own Exposé des Motifs states it implements "l'article 88 point 4" of the Constitution — a direct citation by article number.
